name: 24-7 Press Release
shortNote: Low-cost paid distribution with tiered packages and an account-based submission flow.
limitations: Paid only. Reach is syndication.

name: ACCESS Newswire
shortNote: Press release distribution and investor relations services. Formerly ACCESSWIRE; accesswire.com now redirects here.
limitations: Paid only. Rebranded from ACCESSWIRE, so older references and links point at the previous domain.

name: AI News
shortNote: AI industry news from TechForge, paired with the AI & Big Data Expo event series.
limitations: Only a general contact route exists; whether contributed articles are accepted was not established.

name: AlternativeTo
shortNote: A crowdsourced software alternatives catalogue where a product holds a durable public profile.
limitations: Reached but behind a bot filter, so the submission route could not be read from the site. Needs a browser check. Entries are community-edited, so the description is not under the vendor’s control.

name: American Banker
shortNote: A long-established US banking trade publication read by bank executives and regulators.
limitations: No public submission route was established. Largely subscription-gated.

name: AIM
shortNote: The main Indian AI and data science publication, with a large events and research arm.
limitations: A write-for-us URL resolves but did not state the terms of contribution. Confirm before pitching.

name: ArcticStartup
shortNote: English-language coverage of the Nordic and Baltic startup scene.
limitations: The contact URL redirected to an unrelated article during research, so no route is claimed.

name: Ars Technica
shortNote: Long-form technology journalism with a published contact route for news tips.
limitations: Deeply technical and sceptical of vendor framing. A tip is not coverage.

name: Banking Dive
shortNote: Industry Dive’s banking title, read by banking operators and executives. Its about page carries both a press-release address and a tips route.
limitations: The release route and the editorial tip route are different things; a release is not a story.

name: Benzinga
shortNote: Retail-investor financial news and market commentary.
limitations: A contributor URL was checked and the server returned an error, so the route could not be established.

name: BetaList
shortNote: Early-stage startup discovery aimed at pre-launch and beta products, with a submission queue and a paid option to skip it.
limitations: Free submissions wait in a queue; paid submissions are published sooner. Best fit for genuinely early products.

name: BleepingComputer
shortNote: Breaking security and malware coverage widely cited by other outlets, with a public contact route.
limitations: Incident and research-driven; product launches rarely qualify.

name: Bloomberg
shortNote: Global business and financial news attached to the Bloomberg terminal business.
limitations: No public pitch route was established. Included because it is a standing target on most PR lists, not because a route was found.

name: Breakit
shortNote: Sweden’s startup and technology news site, with a contact page inviting tips to the newsroom.
limitations: Swedish-language pitches about the Nordic ecosystem.

name: Business Wire
shortNote: A Berkshire Hathaway newswire used heavily for regulated financial disclosure and earnings releases.
limitations: Reached but behind a bot filter, so the submission route could not be read from the site. Needs a browser check. Paid only.

name: CNBC
shortNote: Business and markets broadcasting with a large web newsroom.
limitations: No public submission route was established.

name: Computer Weekly
shortNote: The main UK enterprise IT publication, part of Informa TechTarget.
limitations: A contact route was checked and returns 404. Approach through the TechTarget editorial structure.

name: CSO Online
shortNote: Security leadership coverage from Foundry, aimed at CISOs and risk owners.
limitations: No public submission route was established.

name: CSS-Tricks
shortNote: A front-end development publication with a standing guest-writing route.
limitations: Narrow subject scope: front-end technique articles, not company news.

name: Dagens industri
shortNote: Sweden’s principal business daily.
limitations: No public submission route was established. Largely paywalled.

name: Dark Reading
shortNote: An enterprise security publication in the Informa TechTarget group, read by security leadership.
limitations: No contributor or pitch route was established from the site; the about page lists the editorial team only.

name: deutsche-startups.de
shortNote: German startup, venture capital and funding news, with a contact page inviting tips to the editorial desk.
limitations: German market and German-language pitches.

name: DEV Community
shortNote: A developer publishing community where any registered user can publish an article immediately.
limitations: No editorial gate, so reach depends on tags and the community. Overtly promotional posts are downranked.

name: DevHunt
shortNote: A weekly launch board specifically for developer tools, run by the Vercel community.
limitations: Developer tools only; a marketing or finance product does not belong here.

name: Economía Digital
shortNote: Spanish business, corporate and political-economy news with strong regional coverage.
limitations: No public submission route was established.

name: EIN Presswire
shortNote: Mid-priced distribution with a published price list and a large syndication network, including US news-site partners.
limitations: Paid only. Reach is syndication rather than earned coverage.

name: El Referente
shortNote: A Spanish magazine covering startups, investment and innovation.
limitations: No public submission route was established.

name: Emerce
shortNote: Dutch online business, media and marketing publication, with a contact page distinguishing press releases from editorial contact.
limitations: The contact page names both a press-release address and the editorial desk; those are different routes and the release route is not editorial coverage.

name: Entrepreneur Leadership Network
shortNote: Entrepreneur’s paid contributor membership, giving vetted members a publishing route on entrepreneur.com.
limitations: Paid membership with an application. Contributor posts are labelled and rank below staff reporting.

name: EU-Startups
shortNote: Pan-European startup news, funding coverage and a startup database.
limitations: Several submission URLs were checked and all return 404, so the current route could not be established.

name: Expansión
shortNote: Spain’s main business and markets daily.
limitations: No public submission route was established.

name: Expertise Finder
shortNote: A searchable directory of experts used by journalists, built primarily around university faculty.
limitations: Oriented to academic experts; a corporate spokesperson is a weaker fit than a researcher.

name: Fazier
shortNote: A launch board for new products with weekly and monthly leaderboards.
limitations: Small audience relative to Product Hunt; useful as one stop in a launch sequence rather than the whole of it.

name: Featured
shortNote: A question-and-answer platform where experts answer publisher questions for attributed inclusion in articles.
limitations: Reached but behind a bot filter, so the submission route could not be read from the site. Needs a browser check.

name: Finextra
shortNote: Financial technology news with a large member community of banks and vendors.
limitations: A contributors URL was checked and returns 404, so the current route could not be established.

name: Forbes
shortNote: A major global business title. Staff journalism and the paid Councils contributor programme are entirely separate things.
limitations: No open pitch route was established for staff coverage. For the paid publishing route see the Forbes Councils record, which is not staff coverage.

name: Forbes Councils
shortNote: A paid, vetted membership that carries the right to publish articles on Forbes.com under your own byline.
limitations: Membership is an annual fee and applicants are screened. Articles are marked as council posts, which is not the same as Forbes staff coverage.

name: Fortune
shortNote: A major global business title with strong company-ranking franchises.
limitations: No public submission route was established.

name: freeCodeCamp News
shortNote: A developer education publication accepting tutorial and explainer articles from outside authors, with a published style guide.
limitations: Educational articles only. Promotional or company-news submissions are refused.

name: FrenchWeb
shortNote: French business and technology media covering the innovation economy.
limitations: The contact URL redirected to an unrelated article during research, so no route is claimed.

name: GlobeNewswire
shortNote: A global newswire with strong coverage of listed-company and financial disclosure, and a public newsroom carrying every release.
limitations: Paid only. The public newsroom republishes releases verbatim; it is not editorial coverage.

name: Gründerszene
shortNote: German startup and venture coverage. Now published as a section of Business Insider Deutschland; gruenderszene.de redirects there.
limitations: No longer an independent title, so pitches go through the Business Insider Deutschland newsroom rather than a standalone desk.

name: Hacker News
shortNote: Y Combinator’s community board. Show HN is an established route for announcing something you built; anyone can submit.
limitations: No editor and no guarantee of attention. Promotional framing is penalised by the community rather than by a moderator.

name: HackerNoon
shortNote: A technology publication built on outside contributors, where submitted drafts pass through editorial review before publication.
limitations: Review is a real gate and turnaround varies. Sponsored placement is sold separately from the free contributor route.

name: Handelsblatt
shortNote: Germany’s principal business and financial daily.
limitations: No public pitch route was established. Mostly paywalled.

name: Hashnode
shortNote: A developer blogging platform where a company or engineer publishes on their own domain with a shared discovery feed.
limitations: Self-published, so there is no editorial endorsement.

name: Harvard Business Review
shortNote: Management research and practice, with published author guidelines and a formal manuscript submission process.
limitations: An idea with evidence behind it, not company news. Acceptance rates are very low and review is slow.

name: Help Net Security
shortNote: A long-running security news site carrying research summaries, product news and expert commentary.
limitations: A contributions page was not found; only a general contact route exists. Confirm what it accepts before pitching.

name: Help a Reporter Out
shortNote: The original journalist-source service. Cision discontinued it, as Connectively, on 9 December 2024; the brand is reported to have been revived at this domain in 2025.
limitations: The revival could not be confirmed from the site itself, which is behind a bot filter, and Cision’s own notice records the discontinuation. Confirm in a browser before building any workflow on it.

name: HR Dive
shortNote: Industry Dive’s human resources title, covering employment law, benefits and workforce policy.
limitations: Route not individually verified; see the note on the sibling titles.

name: Il Sole 24 Ore
shortNote: Italy’s principal business and financial daily, published by Confindustria.
limitations: No public submission route was established.

name: Indie Hackers
shortNote: A community where founders publish build-in-public posts, milestones and revenue notes under their own name.
limitations: Self-published posts, so reach depends entirely on the community. Not editorial coverage.

name: InfoQ
shortNote: A senior software-engineering publication with a standing "Write for InfoQ" route for practitioner articles.
limitations: Practitioner depth is required and vendor pitches are refused. Editors commission against an editorial calendar.

name: Infosecurity Magazine
shortNote: Information security magazine and conference brand, listing editorial contacts including a contributions route.
limitations: Practitioner-authored analysis rather than product news.

name: ITPro
shortNote: UK enterprise IT news and buying advice, published by Future plc.
limitations: No submission or pitch route was established from the site.

name: JournoLink
shortNote: A UK platform aimed at small businesses, pairing journalist requests with release distribution.
limitations: Paid. Smaller journalist network than ResponseSource.

name: Kauppalehti
shortNote: Finland’s main business and markets publication.
limitations: No public submission route was established.

name: Launching Next
shortNote: A directory of newly launched startups with an open submission form.
limitations: A listing rather than coverage. Paid options move a submission up the queue.

name: Les Echos
shortNote: France’s principal business and financial daily.
limitations: Reached but behind a bot filter, so no route could be read from the site. Needs a browser check.

name: Maddyness
shortNote: The main French startup and innovation title, with a contact page for proposing subjects to the newsroom.
limitations: French-language pitches about the French ecosystem.

name: MarkTechPost
shortNote: AI and machine learning research coverage, heavily focused on new model and paper releases.
limitations: A contribute page was checked and returns 404; only general contact remains.

name: MarTech
shortNote: Marketing technology coverage with a published page on working with its content team, covering both contributed and paid routes.
limitations: Vendor-neutral contributions only; product promotion goes through the paid route.

name: Medium
shortNote: General-purpose publishing where anyone can post immediately. Publications on Medium add an editor, which is a separate and gatekept route.
limitations: Posting to your own profile has no editor and no distribution guarantee; acceptance into a Medium publication does. Do not confuse the two.

name: MentionMatch
shortNote: Connects B2B writers with expert sources. Formerly Help a B2B Writer; helpab2bwriter.com now redirects here.
limitations: B2B focus, so consumer-facing pitches are out of scope. Rebranded, so older references use the previous name.

name: Microlaunch
shortNote: A launch platform aimed at indie makers and micro-SaaS products.
limitations: Niche audience of makers rather than buyers.

name: MT/Sprout
shortNote: Dutch management and entrepreneurship media. MT and Sprout merged into one title, and both mt.nl and sprout.nl now redirect here.
limitations: Reached but behind a bot filter. Two former titles are now one publication, so a pitch to each is a duplicate.

name: Muck Rack
shortNote: A journalist database and PR platform with public journalist profiles, used for targeted pitching rather than broadcast distribution.
limitations: Reached but behind a bot filter, so the submission route could not be read from the site. Needs a browser check. The PR product is paid; journalist profiles are public.

name: Newswire
shortNote: Press release distribution bundled with a media database and pitching tools, aimed at small and mid-sized companies.
limitations: Paid only. The media database and pitching tools are separate products from distribution.

name: openPR
shortNote: Free open press release publishing, with paid options for placement. Submissions are published by the sender rather than commissioned by an editor.
limitations: Open submission means low editorial screening and correspondingly limited authority. Useful for the record, not for earned coverage.

name: OTS
shortNote: The Austrian original-text release service, carrying corporate and institutional announcements in text, image, audio and video.
limitations: Paid distribution service.

name: Peerlist
shortNote: A professional network for builders with a Launchpad where projects are published and voted on.
limitations: Audience is builders and job seekers rather than buyers.

name: PR.com
shortNote: Combines self-service release publishing with a company profile page. The profile and the release are separate submissions.
limitations: Low editorial screening. The company directory function overlaps the business-directory dataset; this record covers the release product.

name: PR Newswire
shortNote: The largest commercial newswire, owned by Cision. Distributes paid releases to newsrooms, terminals and syndication partners worldwide.
limitations: Paid only, priced per release with geographic and industry add-ons. Distribution is not editorial coverage: placement on partner sites is syndication, not a journalist choosing your story.

name: PR Underground
shortNote: Pay-per-release distribution operating since 2010, with published tiers and stated editorial guidelines.
limitations: Paid only, from roughly $75 a release.

name: Pressat
shortNote: UK press release distribution with published packages and a journalist-facing release feed.
limitations: Paid only, with pricing by package.

name: Presseportal
shortNote: The dominant German-language release portal, carrying corporate, police and public-sector newsrooms, operated by news aktuell.
limitations: Publishing requires a paid news aktuell newsroom contract; there is no free submission.

name: pressetext
shortNote: A DACH news agency combining its own editorial desk with a paid release distributor for business, technology and science.
limitations: Paid distribution. The editorial desk and the distribution product are different routes.

name: PRLog
shortNote: Free self-service release publishing, with a paid tier that removes advertising. States on its own submission page that a release can be submitted and distributed for free.
limitations: Anyone can publish, so the archive carries no editorial screening. Treat as a record of announcement, not as media coverage.

name: Product Hunt
shortNote: The largest product launch community. A launch is a dated public post that the community votes on, with its own archive page.
limitations: Ranking is community-driven and one launch per product is the norm; a weak launch day is difficult to repeat.

name: PRWeb
shortNote: Cision’s lower-cost distribution product, aimed at small businesses rather than regulated disclosure.
limitations: Paid only.

name: Quartz
shortNote: Global business and economics coverage with a public contact and tips route.
limitations: A much smaller newsroom than at its peak; pitch volume tolerance is correspondingly lower.

name: Qwoted
shortNote: Journalists post source requests and registered experts respond. The most widely used successor to HARO after Connectively closed.
limitations: A response is a pitch to a reporter, not a placement. Free source accounts are rate-limited; agencies pay.

name: ResponseSource
shortNote: The established UK journalist enquiry service. Journalists send requests to a subscriber network, and subscribers can also send releases.
limitations: Paid subscription for PR users. The enquiry service and the release service are separate products.

name: Retail Dive
shortNote: Industry Dive’s retail title, covering chains, ecommerce and consumer brands.
limitations: Its own about route was not individually verified; the sibling titles publish a tips address, but that is the platform’s pattern rather than proof for this title.

name: SaaSHub
shortNote: A software alternatives and discovery site where a product gets a persistent profile page alongside competitors.
limitations: The profile is the durable asset; the launch is secondary. Overlaps software review directories.

name: SaaStr
shortNote: The largest B2B SaaS community, combining a blog, podcast and annual event.
limitations: The site is oriented to its events and community; no open contributor route was established.

name: Search Engine Land
shortNote: The reference search marketing publication, running a contributor programme alongside paid sponsorship.
limitations: Contributors are expected to be named practitioners, not agencies pitching clients. Sponsorship is a separate paid product.

name: SecurityWeek
shortNote: Enterprise security news and an ICS security conference brand.
limitations: A write-for-us route was checked and does not exist. Approach via the editorial team.

name: Shifter
shortNote: Norwegian technology, innovation and startup business news.
limitations: No public submission route was established.

name: Sifted
shortNote: European startup and venture coverage, originally backed by the Financial Times, with a contact route for story tips.
limitations: European companies and investors only. Much of the deeper reporting sits behind Sifted Pro.

name: Silicon UK
shortNote: UK business technology news aimed at IT decision makers.
limitations: The contact route redirect-looped during research and no submission path was established.

name: SiliconANGLE
shortNote: Enterprise technology news paired with theCUBE video coverage of industry events.
limitations: The contact URL redirected to an unrelated article during research, so no route is claimed here.

name: Smashing Magazine
shortNote: A long-standing front-end and design publication with an explicit "Write for us" route and paid rates for accepted articles.
limitations: Standards are high and the queue is long. Product promotion is refused.

name: SourceBottle
shortNote: Connects journalists, bloggers and writers with expert sources, with the strongest coverage in Australia and New Zealand.
limitations: Volume is lower than the US platforms outside Australasian markets.

name: StartupBase
shortNote: A daily launch and discovery board for new products, requiring an account to submit.
limitations: Smaller audience than Product Hunt.

name: StartupItalia
shortNote: Italian startup and innovation coverage with an events arm.
limitations: Reached but behind a bot filter. Needs a browser check.

name: Substack
shortNote: Newsletter publishing where a company or founder runs its own title and owns the subscriber list.
limitations: Self-publishing, so there is no third-party endorsement and no borrowed audience. Placement in someone else’s Substack is a separate, unlisted arrangement.

name: Supply Chain Dive
shortNote: Industry Dive’s logistics and supply chain title.
limitations: Route not individually verified; see the note on the sibling titles.

name: Synced
shortNote: AI research and industry coverage with strong reporting on Chinese AI labs.
limitations: No public submission route was established.

name: t3n
shortNote: The leading German digital-business magazine, with a contact page naming the editorial desk.
limitations: German-language pitches. The editorial desk and the advertising department are separate routes.

name: Talouselämä
shortNote: A Finnish business magazine covering companies, management and the economy.
limitations: No public submission route was established.

name: Tech.eu
shortNote: European technology and funding news with a published advertising and sponsored-content offer.
limitations: Only the paid route is documented on the site; an editorial pitch route was not established. The two are different things.

name: TechCrunch
shortNote: The reference startup and venture publication. Its tips page is the documented route for sending news to reporters.
limitations: A tip is not coverage. Funding rounds and launches are the usual hooks; unsolicited product pitches rarely land.

name: The Hacker News
shortNote: One of the most-read security news sites, with a standing page for submitting news and tips.
limitations: Security news only. Vendor announcements without a threat or research angle are refused.

name: The New Stack
shortNote: Cloud-native and platform-engineering coverage with a published contributions route for technical articles, alongside a sponsorship programme.
limitations: The contributed route is editorial and free; sponsorship is a separate paid product. Contributions must be vendor-neutral.

name: The Register
shortNote: Enterprise IT news with a sceptical house style, publishing a page on how to contact its journalists directly.
limitations: Openly hostile to marketing language. Approach with a story, not a release.

name: TNW
shortNote: European technology media and conference brand, owned by the Financial Times group.
limitations: No public submission route was established; the conference and the publication are separate products.

name: TinyLaunch
shortNote: A one-a-day launch board for small products. tinylaun.ch redirects here.
limitations: Very small audience. Value is the backlink and the launch artefact rather than traffic.

name: Towards Data Science
shortNote: A data science and machine learning publication built on outside authors, with a published route for new writers.
limitations: Technical articles by named practitioners; company announcements are out of scope.

name: Uneed
shortNote: A launch board for tools and SaaS products. The submission form pre-fills from the product page before an account is needed.
limitations: Free listings queue; paid slots are promoted.

name: Unite.AI
shortNote: AI news, research summaries and tool reviews.
limitations: A write-for-us page existed previously and now returns 410 Gone, so the contributor route is closed or moved.

name: WirtschaftsWoche
shortNote: A leading German business weekly covering companies, markets and management.
limitations: No public submission route was established.

name: ZDNET
shortNote: Long-established technology news and reviews, now heavily weighted to buying advice.
limitations: No public pitch or contributor route was established.
